name: Downwind Ambusher
description:
Flash
When this creature enters, choose one —
• Target creature an opponent controls gets -1/-1 until end of turn.
• Destroy target creature an opponent controls that was dealt damage this turn.
assumptions: Read owner:opp on both E and F, combined with the target flag, as "target creature an opponent controls" rather than an untargeted symmetric effect.
Rendered node C (a root, static modifier node carrying flags:flash on self) as the printed keyword ability "Flash" rather than a gated/conditional effect, since it's ungated and self-referential.
Wrote D's combine:1-of-[E,F] group as "choose one —" per the schema's stated convention that a numeric combine count is a genuine modal choice.
notes: Second attempt, after the translator fix adding a wasDealtDamageThisTurn qualifier as a cond: flag on the destroy mode's move node (F). Confirmed the fix landed and is correctly interpreted: F now carries flags 'target cond:was_damaged_this_turn' alongside owner:opp, and the blind reconstruction rendered this as 'Destroy target creature an opponent controls that was dealt damage this turn' -- an exact match to the real oracle text's second mode, and to Forge's own ValidTgts$ Creature.OppCtrl+wasDealtDamageThisTurn. Every other element also matches exactly: mana cost {3}{B}, type line Creature -- Skunk Assassin (4/2), the Flash keyword (node C), the ETB modal trigger structure ('choose one --', combine:1 of two branches), and mode 1's wording (target creature an opponent controls gets -1/-1 until end of turn, from node E). Nothing invented, nothing missing. No decomposition gap, schema gap, or agent misinterpretation remains for this card -- the specific defect this second attempt was designed to catch (the missing wasDealtDamageThisTurn qualifier) is resolved.
